description: Quote and buy the $9 full teardown for a roast. Step 1: call with just the roast_id — you get the quote and nothing is charged, no checkout session is created. Step 2: only after the user has said yes, call again with confirmPaymentSpend: true to create the Stripe checkout session and get the URL for them to pay at. PageRoast has no accounts and stores no card, so the payment happens on Stripe's own page.

confirmPaymentSpend.description: Set to true only after the user has approved the $9 purchase. Without it this tool only quotes.

name: buy_full_teardown
